services.name: SceneResource_LoadOrClearC000
services.behavior: Clears C000 when SCENE_RESOURCE_C000_SOURCE is null, otherwise invokes the RNC-to-VDP loader.

services.name: SceneResource_PrepareFrameAndPalette
services.behavior: Waits for VBlank, begins the palette transition, clears C000, and uploads palette band 3.

services.name: SceneResource_InstantiateActorRecord
services.record_format: template pointer longword, X word, Y word
services.behavior: Skips records whose Y low byte is zero; otherwise finds a free slot, initializes the template, and writes X/Y.

services.name: VDP_CopyLevelF800Tilemap
services.behavior: Copies 0x400 words from ROM 0x0011F000 to VRAM 0xF800 through VDP_CopyWordsToVRAM.

conclusion: The scene-resource command table now has explicit names for its conditional C000 loader, frame/palette preparation handler, and actor-record instantiator. The level-specific F800 tilemap transfer is separated from the fixed scene F800 transfer.
